question: India topped the medals tally in the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup-2022, which was held in Cairo, Egypt from _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**26 February 2022 to 8 March 2022**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India topped the medals tally in the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup 2022 held in Cairo, Egypt.
 
• The event took place from **26 February 2022 to 8 March 2022**.
 
• Indian shooters secured a total of **seven medals**, including 4 gold, 2 silver, and 1 bronze.
 
• India emerged as the overall leader in the tournament, outperforming strong competitors like Norway and Germany.
 
• This was a significant achievement for India, showcasing the growing dominance of Indian shooters on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ISSF World Cup:**

 
 
• The ISSF World Cup is an annual competition in shooting sports organized by the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF).
 
• It includes events for rifles, pistols, and shotguns, catering to elite shooters from around the world.
 
• The competition is considered one of the most prestigious shooting events globally.
 
 
 
• **India's Shooting Achievements:**
 
 
• India has consistently performed well in shooting sports, with notable shooters like Abhinav Bindra and Manu Bhaker leading the charge.
 
• Abhinav Bindra remains the only Indian shooter to win an Olympic gold medal (2008 Beijing Olympics).
 
 
 
• **Key Events in ISSF World Cup:**
 
 
• The ISSF World Cup features events like 10m Air Rifle, 10m Air Pistol, Trap, Skeet, and Mixed Team competitions.
 
• Each event tests precision, accuracy, and consistency under competitive conditions.
 
 
 
• **Cairo as the Host City:**
 
 
• Cairo, Egypt, hosted the ISSF World Cup 2022, providing excellent facilities and infrastructure for the event.
 
• The city has a rich history of hosting international sports tournaments.
